course.title: Power System I
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: Describe the needs of modulation. Write down the names of different digital modulation techniques. Calculate the nominal bandwidth required for ASK, PSK and FSK modulations when bits ‘1’ and ‘0’ having bit rates 1.5 Kb/s are modulated by carrier frequencies 2.5 MHz and 2.3 MHz, respectively.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
